source: Read-only task outputs, final event files, current process/open-file/session state and snapshot consumer inspection. Identifiers/endpoints omitted.
observer_observation: Periodic observer remains; current service observation unavailable. A live observer does not mean active firmware execution.
stale_progress_status: Old static in_progress status is not current execution proof. Final event records indicate completed turns, not completed overall goal.
user_retention_decision: Preserve this unfinished task; no observer stop, cancellation or unique input/result deletion in this task.

snapshot_candidate_audit.state: Candidate upper bound; not reclaimed space or full per-member SHA proof.
snapshot_candidate_audit.possible_optimization: COW clones can preserve original paths and content without cancelling the task; only actual verified execution and volume free-space readback can establish reclaimed bytes.
